title: Web client: basic CSS
description:
Write the two-column CSS layout for the kith web client. No framework.

What: style.css providing two-column layout, message bubbles, legible on mobile.

Algorithm:
1. Write /home/mark/WORK/KITH/web/style.css with:
   - CSS reset: box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0 on *
   - Body: font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column
   - #app: display: flex; flex: 1; overflow: hidden
   - .sidebar: width: 280px; border-right: 1px solid #ddd; overflow-y: auto; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column
   - .main: flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden
   - .chat-list, .contact-list: list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0
   - .chat-item, .contact-item: padding: 12px 16px; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0
   - .chat-item:hover, .contact-item:hover: background: #f5f5f5
   - .chat-item.active: background: #e8f0fe
   - .unread-badge: background: #1a73e8; color: white; border-radius: 12px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px
   - .message-thread: flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px
   - .message: max-width: 70%; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; word-break: break-word
   - .message.self: align-self: flex-end; background: #1a73e8; color: white; border-radius: 12px 12px 2px 12px
   - .message.peer: align-self: flex-start; background: #f1f3f4; color: #202124; border-radius: 12px 12px 12px 2px
   - .message-meta: font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; margin-top: 4px
   - .compose: padding: 12px 16px; border-top: 1px solid #ddd; display: flex; gap: 8px
   - .compose textarea: flex: 1; resize: none; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; font-family: inherit; min-height: 40px; max-height: 120px
   - .compose button: padding: 8px 16px; background: #1a73e8; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer
   - .error-banner: background: #fce8e6; color: #d93025; padding: 12px 16px; display: none
   - Mobile (@media max-width: 600px): .sidebar width: 100% or hidden when chat selected; .main width: 100%
   - Monospace for code in messages: .message code: font-family: monospace; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px

Defensive programming rules:
- No JavaScript in CSS.
- Mobile viewport must be usable (touch targets ≥ 44px).
- No external fonts or CDN references.

Tests (visual inspection via integration test):
- Rendered page has two columns on desktop viewport.
- Switches to single column at 600px width.
- Message bubbles are distinguishable by alignment and color.
